notes.title: Daring Academy Alpha 0.1.0 is coming on January 1st, 2024!
notes.content:
Here it is, the version you've all been waiting for, Alpha 0.1.0...

Daring Academy Alpha 0.1.0 is divided into two versions: Original Version and Chapter 1 Demo.

Differences on the Chapter 1 Demo:
[list]
[*] It's available on Steam Itch.io and Gamejolt for free, even when the main game is done (0.1.0 to 1.0.0 will only be available on Itch.io)
[*] Achievements are removed, due to an issue on Steam's end
[*] Backgrounds in UIs are changed to the apartment, indicating the moving in of the main character and Amelia
[*] Anything regarding the full game has been changed to mention the demo, that includes logos, version numbers, etc
[/list]

We strongly recommend you play the Chapter 1 Demo to get a feel of the game, as if you plan on getting all achievements in the game, saves from the Chapter 1 Demo won't give the achievements from Chapter 1 upon playing Chapter 2 and onward, due to issues with Steam demos and all.

Note: As with any alphas, there are a ton of internal code changes and file reorganizations, so saves might not be compatible between the old versions. Alpha 0.1.0 and onwards will try to keep as much support with Chapter 1 saves as possible, but may become incompatible in future updates, so beware.

For Steam Deck Users: While playtesting the game on Steam Deck, we encountered an issue in Desktop Mode where the keyboard wouldn't show up if it the game was in fullscreen mode, even when pressing Steam+X. If this issue appears to you, please connect a keyboard to your device. The keyboard works fully in gaming mode though.

If you have Decky Loader on your Steam Deck, you can change the artworks of the Chapter 1 demo build using SteamGridDB plugin​. See the [url=https://github.com/SteamGridDB/decky-steamgriddb]official GitHub for SteamGridDB[/url] to learn how.

A massive thanks to Imbion, Jenivere, Kalosmuffins, Kit from "Kit\'s Workshop", K0maru, RedRan6er, Wavi, LemonadeMochi, Dark_Green, Carter Vandenberg, UnlishedTen8, optimistic1236, SelLillianna, spottyboi, Jayne/Koriko, Twotoneinc, TimberRaven, bikifrench, chlodiami, Alexei, genderlurker, angelicangela., kortniblini, aksanaip, alainax, bdkcisme, jankbithle, Jaydon (A), Gauncamole, Fabryn, Hallowuette, ayinsis and everyone I missed for playtesting throughout 0.0.1 to 0.1.0's development phase. This demo wouldn't be possible without all of you.

You can download and play 0.0.1, known as the Legacy Edition to see all the progress in 3 years of development. This edition of 0.0.1 doesn't change the story from said version but adds smaller things like a smaller cursor, Discord rich presence support, etc. Go to https://thediamondcryst.itch.io/daring-academy-chapter-1-demo or select the Legacy branch in the Steam build settings to play it. Note: Any issues in this version will not be fixed. Saves in that version of the game are also not compatible with the Chapter 1 Demo, 0.1.0, or the full game.

As a final thank you, thanks to Dandelier for making the image in the header perfectly representing Chapter 1. See more of his images in Chapter 2 and beyond!

notes.title: Daring Academy Alpha 0.0.6 is coming on January 1st, 2023!
notes.content:
While not adding the voice sound effects like wanted, due to internal issues and all, this update still adds a lot of useful aspects to the game, mainly the Music Room, colored textboxes, and all. This update acts as a polishing update for Chapter 1, and add code for Chapter 2.

Unfortunately, Alpha 0.1.0 might take longer to be released, as I recently moved out and need to buy more for it, like a desk, chair, and such. I sincerely apologize for that.

Note: As with any alphas, there are a ton of internal code changes, so saves might not be compatible between the old versions, so beware.

Important note: There is an issue with the new Discord Rich presence code that may crash/freeze the game upon full restart of Windows or recompiling of the game and Discord is opened. To fix this, close the game, open Task Manager, right click Discord select "End Task", then open the game again. A proper fix is in investigation and will be fixed in a future update.

Thanks to SelLillianna and Jaydon (A) for playtesting throughout Alpha 0.0.6's development phase.

notes.title: Daring Academy Alpha 0.0.5 is coming on October 7th, 2022!
notes.content:
If you were paying attention during Alpha 0.0.5's development, you know there was supposed to have an Alpha 0.0.4.1. Well, due to an issue concerning the new "Catching Moments" and TuneCore, a music distribution service which both "Monster Orb, The Game We Play" and "Lily's Sorrow" were uploaded on to be distributed on YouTube Music, Spotify and such, it got merged with Alpha 0.0.5.

This update mainly changes the phone system to a better looking one, adding the stat system back, and enhancing it by adding the Relationship Status screen, and changing "Catching Moments" to have it sung by Zoemaria44 (The original version is in the Additional Soundtrack, don't worry), this massive update solves as a polishing update to be ready for a demo on Itch.io and Steam.

The next update should hopefully be an Alpha 0.0.5.1 update, probably adding Voice Sound Effects, or be in the Alpha 0.1 update, which closes sole development on Chapter 1 and focusing on Chapter 2.

Note: As with any alphas, there are a ton of internal code changes, so saves might not be compatible between the old versions, so beware.

Thanks to everyone who playtested throughout Alpha 0.0.5's development phase.

notes.title: Daring Academy Alpha 0.0.4 is coming on July 1st, 2022!
notes.content:
Right when Alpha 0.0.3 was done and waiting to be released, we started working on this update, fixing stuff forgotten from Alpha 0.0.3 and such.

While mainly adding Day 4, Alpha 0.0.4 also adds the new character customization screen, new songs, partial controller support, a new insert song sung by Amelia Sweet, adds new characters, changes internal stuff, adds quality of life changes and many more.

Thanks to LemonadeMochi, Dark_Green, Carter Vandenberg and UnlishedTen8 for playtesting throughout Alpha 0.0.4's development phase.

[list]
[*] Desaturated the grocery store background, to resemble the one used in the day 3 divider
[*] Renamed the gallery screen to "In-Game Gallery"
[*] Moved the gallery to the Gallery Section screen
[*] Aligned the character name's text position in the character bio to be centered with itself
[*] Bolded the categories in the character bio to easily identify them
[*] Disabled all non-original sound effects, as to not create any stress on finding sound effects
[*] Limited the number of saves and load pages to 15 pages, with automatic saves and quick saves
[/list]
Added:
[list]
[*] Added a option to choose your last name, with Lullena as the default last name
[*] Added Day 4
[*] Added a day divider to Day 1
[*] Added mentions of Fruits Basket, Re:Zero Starting Life in Another World, Minecraft, Ori and the Blind Forest, Ori and the Will of the Wisps and Sword Art Online in the credits
[*] Added a content warning screen upon first loading up the game
[*] Added hover icons to the extras screen
[*] Added the day dividers to the in-game gallery screen, unlocked when seeing the day divider
[*] Added 3 new achievements
[*] Added lines when a character is talking in the background of phone calls
[*] Added the "Birthday" category in the bio screen, thus adding birthdays to Minty and Delilah
[*] Added Severus, a new character, to the start of the game
[*] Added Loya, Kitt and Wisp Kitt (Actual name being "Kitt (In his wisp form)")
[*] Added Clementine to normal gameplay
[*] Added Discord Rich Presence to the main menu and credits
[*] Added a Continue Game button, to easily continue your latest save
[*] Added "About", "Options" and "Help" tabs to the option, about and help screen screens
[*] Added the inappropriate action (Bullying, blood, etc.) selector (Called "Violence/Blood" as of 0.0.4) before the main menu (Will be used later) (Forgot to prompt it in Alpha 0.0.2 to Alpha 0.0.4)
[*] Added the profanity and violence/blood selector to the options menu
[*] Added reminders, notifications inspired by The Walking Dead
[*] Added a content warning button in the options screen
[*] Added a toggle side images option
[*] Added a line in Day 3 mentioning Rose gave the main character and Amelia her phone number
[*] Added tooltips to all settings
[*] Added a textbox opacity slider
[*] Added a quick menu opacity slider
[*] Added custom pronouns support, with He/Him, She/Her, They/Them, It/Its and Ze/Zir as default available options
[*] Added notify to the bio screen when clicking a locked bio
[*] Added notify to the achievement screen when clicking a locked achievement
[*] Added a "Show Credits" button to the About screen
[*] Added a white selection to gallery images and bio icons
[*] Added partial controller support (Typing text inputs still needs keyboard to proceed)
[*] Added gallery introduction images for Minty and Delilah due to their important nature in Daring Academy
[*] Added voice sound effects when hovering over the hidden pat button, patting and hovering out the hidden pat button on Minty and Delilah (Thanks to TheAtomicMarshmallow and Lexinator for voicing them)
[*] Added a visual queue to the hidden pat button on Minty and Delilah when hovered
[*] Added pats in Day 1 when Minty and Delilah comes back from offscreen
[*] Added a transition when clicking the "New Game" button
[*] Added hover icons in the bio screen
[/list]
Changed:
[list]
[*] Changed the section to name your character, choose your gender, etc. to a screen
[*] Changed the default male name from "Lee" to "Lenny" (Apparently, I switched them around in Alpha 0.0.2 lol)
[*] Changed the default male nickname from "Lee" to "Len" (Apparently, I switched them around in Alpha 0.0.2 lol)
[*] Changed all girl's name references to look for both the first name and last name to activate the name reference instead of the first name only
[*] Changed Kirito and Asuna's name references to look for the nickname "Kirito" for Kirito and "Asuna" for Asuna or the first name "Kazuto" for Kirito or "Asuna" for Asuna and the last name "Kirigaya" for Kirito and "Yuuki" for Asuna
[*] Changed Yui's name reference to look for the nickname "Yui" or the first name "Yui"
[*] Changed Subaru Natsuki's name reference to look for the first name "Subaru" and the last name "Natsuki"
[*] Changed the shattering wine bottle image's floor, to resemble the desaturated version of the grocery store background
[*] Changed the in-game gallery screen to use the full character names instead of the first name
[*] Changed the character bio to use the main character's full name in Amelia, Minty and Delilah's bio description
[*] Changed the in-game gallery image's description to mention the the main character's full name when mentioning the main character
[*] Changed the in-game gallery image's description to change "(male version, or dressed manly)" and "(female version, or dressed femininely)" to "as a guy, or dressed manly" and "as a girl, or dressed femininely" accordingly
[*] Changed Minty and Delilah's bio species from 'Neko (Nekomusume)' to 'Cat Girl'
[*] Changed the icon for Day Two - Bonding Time to use the new apartment image
[*] Changed the Pet Minty and Pet Delilah achievements to color Minty and Delilah's name in its description
[*] Changed all achievement pop-ups to mostly use full character names, and coloring them for consistency with other aspects of the game
[*] Changed the section when you choose your subject to mention automatic saves instead of quick saves
[*] Changed Elizabeth's bio's height from 165 cm to 162 cm
[*] Changed Minty's bio age from '2 years & 10 months old' to '18 cat years old'
[*] Changed Delilah's bio age from '2 years & 11 months old' to '25 cat years old'
[*] Changed Amelia's contact name when the phone is shown from "Amelia🥇♥" to "♥ Millie (Amelia) ♥"
[*] Changed the phone system to have more options (Thanks to nadia nova for providing a free template)
[*] Changed the daydream girl's flower field images from screens to image composites
[*] Changed mentions of "catgirl(s)" to "cat girl(s)"
[*] Changed the apartment images to better match up with the Sims inspiration (Thanks to Yuri Arts for it)
[*] Changed all tiny text from tiny characters to using "{size=15}", making use of the same font
[*] Changed the "Last Dance" and "Monster Orb, The Game We Play" option in Day to use quotations instead of an apostrophe in Amelia's texts, creating consistencies with the "Moody" option
[*] Changed choice menu options to italicize action options (Like "Ask her to delete the photo", etc)
[*] Changed the captions to color names and italicize text
[*] Changed the "Sound & Music Captions" to have two options: "Toggle Sound Captions" and "Toggle Music Captions"
[*] Changed the saves and load page number shown on screen from 9 to 15, with automatic saves and quick saves
[*] Changed the game's logo in the main menu to say "Alpha Version" instead of "Alpha Build"
[*] Changed Amelia's image when on the ground to have the apartment's new floor design, and remove the hair ribbon
[*] Changed the floor tiles background when the main character's phone is shown to have the apartment's new floor design
[*] Changed the description of ungranted achievements to "This achievement has not been unlocked yet." in italic instead of its description
[*] Changed "Day One - Moving Day"'s achievement icon to have the apartment's new floor design
[*] Changed the "Press Backspace to exit." text in the Extras screen, the achievement screen, the bio screen and the in-game gallery screen to a "Back" button (Backspace functionality still works however)
[*] Changed Lily's bio description to not include a 1:1 copy of Amelia's bio description (Thanks to GreasyPaint for pointing it out)
[*] Changed a line in Day 2 to fix the phrasing regarding the Always On Display line
[*] Changed the "Return" button in the history screen to be italicized
[*] Changed all gallery introduction images to include better descriptions and color names
[*] Changed the direction in Day 2 when Amelia goes in the kitchen from left to right
[*] Changed the text in the save and load screen from "empty slot" to "This slot is empty." in italics
[/list]
Renamed:
[list]
[*] Renamed the gallery screen to "In-Game Gallery"
[*] Renamed the start button to "New Game"
[*] Renamed the save button to "Save Game"
[*] Renamed the load button to "Load Game"
[*] Renamed the preferences screen and button to "Options"
[*] Renamed the main menu button to "Return to Menu"
[*] Renamed the "No need." option to "No need, thank you!"
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
[*] Fixed Day 1, Day 2 and Day 3's spelling mistakes (Thanks to Jenivere)
[*] Fixed Day 2's day divider background to be 1280x720, not 1280x717, removing transparency from it at the top and bottom in the game itself
[*] Fixed Delilah's collar missing the bell's color during the phone call scenes.
[*] Fixed the text box showing in Day 3 when Amelia moves to the left and jumps
[*] Fixed an issue in Day 1 where Delilah would keep her mouth opened if you selected the "I know what you mean, Millie..." option
[*] Fixed an issue in Day 1 where Amelia would keep her mouth opened for longer than expected when her grandparents says they're home
[*] Fixed an issue in Day 1 where Amelia would sigh weirdly when in her their new apartment
[*] Fixed Amelia's sigh position to be more aligned with her mouth
[*] Fixed an issue where after patting Minty or Delilah, it would skip to the next dialogue
[*] Fixed an issue where Amelia would suddenly appear when going in the apartment, choosing the "Wake her up" option
[*] Fixed an issue where in some part of Day 2 and Day 3, Amelia's name wouldn't be colored
[*] Fixed an issue where in some part of Day 3, Delilah's name wouldn't be colored
[*] Fixed an issue where the blur when the Monster Orb card "Strike!" was hidden, it would hide it instantly
[*] Fixed an issue where when exiting the Extras Screen, it would go back to the game instead of the previously opened menu
[*] Fixed an issue where the notify when clicking a locked gallery image wouldn't show
[*] Fixed an issue where if the "Sound & Music Captions" setting option is on and a sound effect played at the same time as a bio or a gallery unlock notification, it would only show one of the notify
[*] Fixed an issue in Day 2 where the window wouldn't hide during Amelia's moveinleft transition
[*] Fixed an issue where when Day 3's day divider would hide, it would hide abruptly
[*] Fixed a spelling mistake in Bernard's description where `Helen` was all lowercased
[*] Fixed an issue in Day 1 where when the player clicked the option "Wake Her Up", Amelia would appear abruptly
[*] Fixed an issue where Delilah's name would unlock before her bio is unlocked
[*] Fixed an issue in Day 1 where when the player clicked the option "Hug her", Amelia and the main character would appear abruptly
[*] Fixed an issue in Day 1 where if the player clicked the option "Hug her" and the hug image hid, Amelia, Minty and Delilah would appear abruptly
[*] Fixed an issue where at one part in Day 1, Minty would talk, but not open her mouth
[*] Fixed an issue where in the save and load screens, the save image was getting over the white outline 
[/list]
Removed:
[list]
[*] Removed Undertale name references (Forgot to remove them in Alpha 3)
[*] Removed Hollow Knight name reference (Forgot to remove them in Alpha 3)
[*] Removed the help and about buttons from the main menu
[*] Removed the Ren'Py license from the about screen, due to an issue where the "here" wouldn't change color and go italic (Due to it being hard-coded into the Ren'Py engine itself)
[*] Removed the Rollback Side option
[/list]

notes.title: Daring Academy Alpha 0.0.3 is coming on March 14th, 2022!
notes.content:
After 3 months of work, and help from playtesters and more, embark in the most impactful update of Daring Academy as of now: Alpha 0.0.3!

Alpha 0.0.3 will arrive on the [url=https://thediamondcryst.itch.io/daring-academy]Daring Academy Itch.io[/url] page on March 14, 2022 and mainly adds Day 2 and Day 3, but adds new characters, changes internal stuff, adds quality of life changes, original songs and many others. 

Thanks to Imbion, Jenivere, Kalosmuffins, Kit from "Kit\'s Workshop", K0maru, LemonadeMochi, RedRan6er and Wavi for playtesting throughout Alpha 0.0.3's development phase.
[list]
[*] Updated to Ren'Py version 7.4.11.2266
[*] Renamed all of the main character's sprites from "mc" to "main_character"
[*] Disabled the second page in the character bio screen
[*] Aligned the character bio character boxes to the center
[*] Condensed the "Song Titles" and "SFX Titles" from the "Captions" section in the preferences menu to "Sound & Music Captions"
[*] Capitalized mentions of week days
[/list]
Added:
[list]
[*] Added Rose and Elizabeth to normal gameplay
[*] Added Rose, Lily, Elizabeth and Clementine's bios (Lily and Clementine's bio not available in normal gameplay)
[*] Added Day 2 and Day 3
[*] Added a "Skip Credits" button upon seeing the credits at least once
[*] Added day dividers for Day 2 and 3, featuring artworks from the community
[*] Added more dialogues to Day 1, mentioning Minty and Master Wyllhelm moving into a new apartment
[*] Added colors to when character names are mentioned in the game, achievement screen, bio screen and gallery screen's descriptions
[*] Added 2 new achievements
[*] Added a bio for the main character, with the icon changing based on the gender, and name adjusting to the player's input
[*] Added a version number to the bottom of gameplay, to indicate you're playing an alpha, beta, pre-release or dev version of the game (Will be removed once Release 1.0 will be released)
[/list]
Changed:
[list]
[*] Changed the code to lower any data to lowercase and underscores
[*] Changed the code and images to change any mentions of "Guy" and "Girl" to "Male" and "Female"
[*] Changed the description of locked achievements from "???" to "[i]This achievement has not been unlocked yet.[/i]" in italic
[*] Changed the achievement screen title from "Achievement Screen:" to "Achievement Screen"
[*] Changed the bio screen character information title from "Character Information:" to "Character Information"
[*] Changed the about screen to reflect the Steam and Itch.io description, and mention every artists who helped with Daring Academy's soundtrack
[*] Changed Clementine and Elizabeth's name colors
[*] Changed the parallax in the main menu to be smoother
[*] Changed the skip indicator to be consistent with all GUIs
[*] Changed the skip indicator's "Skipping" text to be in italic
[*] Changed the version number indicator in the About screen and main menu to be in italic
[*] Changed all songs used in Daring Academy to original songs by Saddle Studios, Dragonz and Thediamondcrystal, or insert songs by Lil Wawa, N.T, JustLetterH, etc. Most old songs will be in the Daring Academy (Additional Soundtrack)
[*] Changed the code of Day 1 to use "amelia_grandparents_house_day.webp" as background, not "amelia_grandparents_house_day_test.webp"
[*] Changed the hug image base used in Day 1 to contain lines in the main character's hair (Both versions)
[*] Changed Bernard's bio icon to include the jaw lines in its' sprite
[*] Changed the flower background in the daydream, the amelia photo icon and gallery image to contain more variety of flowers at different heights, and fix the perspective
[*] Changed the daydream part to be in a sunset part, and include more variety of flowers at different heights, and fix the perspective
[*] Changed "Pet Minty" and "Pet Delilah"'s achievement icons to use chibi versions, inspired by Nekopara's pet achievements
[*] Changed Ori and Ku's name references to not include quotes from Ori and the Blind Forest and Ori and the Will of the Wisps
[*] Changed iso bios are unlocked when a character name is mentioned
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
[*] Fixed Day 1's spelling mistakes
[*] Fixed an issue where when if a character wasn't introduced, the name would still show up
[*] Fixed issues where the bottom textbox indicator wouldn't be present in transitions
[*] Fixed an issue where bios, achievements and gallery notifications were showing again when rolling back
[*] Fixed an issue where the splash screen would loop twice upon first starting the game
[*] Fixed the part where the flowers when the daydream girl zooms to her side wouldn't follow the zoom
[*] Fixed Rose's side image bio's placement to see more of her' body and match the other characters more
[*] Fixed the main character's side image bio's placement to see more of its' body and match the other characters more
[/list]
Removed:
[list]
[*] Removed the "Skip" category in the preferences menu, thus removing the "Unseen Text", "After Choices" and "Transitions" options
[*] Removed the "Toggle" option in the preferences menu, thus removing the "Screenshake" and "Self-Voicing" options
[*] Removed the "Image Descriptions" option in the preferences menu
[*] Removed the "amelia_grandparents_house_day.webp" image from the game files and renamed "amelia_grandparents_house_day_test.webp" to "amelia_grandparents_house_day.webp"
[*] Removed all mentions of song lyrics
[*] Removed Undertale name references 
[*] Removed Hollow Knight name reference
[*] Removed most references from Day 1
[/list]

Thanks to frogs.pure for making the day divider for Day 3, and the background image used in the cover and header images.

notes.title: The first small fix update for Daring Academy is out!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who played Daring Academy Alpha 0.0.2. This itch.io update fixes 8 issues/small bugs to help make the playing experience better to anyone.

[list]
[*] Fixed the Steam icon on the main menu having a random white line/splot on the side
[*] Fixed an issue where some names were not colored.
[*] Fixed helen's character side image not having her mouth opened when talking off screen
[*] Fixed the discord rich presence showing as morning when it was sunset in-game
[*] Fixed an issue where the quick menu still showed in the pre-credits and credits
[*] Fixed an issue where if Minty or Delilah is petted, the "textbox_bottom" image would appear as a grey Eileen
[*] Changed the extra screens' escape button to Backspace and disabling the Esc key and right click button, fixing an issue where if Esc was pressed, GUIs (Like the text window for characters) would hide
[*] Removed the achievement screen from the options in the main menu
[/list]

Please remember that a Steam release will come one the game will be in a demo phase.

notes.title: Daring Academy Alpha 0.0.2 is coming on January 1st!
notes.content:
After a whole year in the making, embark in the biggest update of Daring Academy as of now: Alpha 0.0.2!

Complete with a whole rewrite of Day 1, new menus, optimizations, this update will arrive on the [url=https://thediamondcryst.itch.io/daring-academy]Daring Academy Itch.io page[/url] on January 1st, 2022. Steam release will come one the game will be in a demo phase.

[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added animations between scenes and characters
[*] Added non-binary support for the main character
[*] Added default names for the main character (Lee, Layla and Lenny)
[*] Added default nicknames for the main character (Lee, Lay and Len)
[*] Added the question in choice menus (NVL mode for important questions, AVL for normal questions)
[*] Added Discord rich presence
[*] Added 5 new achievements
[*] Added new characters: Lily Cortez, Rose Wheatley, Elizabeth Robinson, Clementine Neonica, Helen (Luna Sweet), Bernard Sweet, Ruby Sweet, Alain Nadeau, Young Amelia
[*] Added an inappropriate action (Bullying, blood, etc.) selector before the main menu (Will be used later)
[*] Added a swears selector before the main menu (Will be used more later)
[*] Added a gallery screen (Thanks to I_Am_Boredom on Discord for coding it)
[*] Added name references
[*] Added a character bio screen (Thanks to I_Am_Boredom on Discord for coding it)
[*] Changed so the main character's name input is limited to 16 character instead of infinity
[*] Changed the start of the game to include a daydream
[*] Changed Amelia's sprites to remove wrinkles on her shirt and fixed her proportion
[*] Changed all humanoid characters to use layered images instead of using image composition, thus opening tons of new possibility for clothes combos
[*] Changed the main menu to add parallax and a animated background to the main menu
[*] Changed the "Day One - Moving Day" achievement's description from "Complete your first day in Olis." to "Complete your first day in Olis with going out and visit the city."
[*] Changed the words "Boy" and "Girl" to "Male" and "Female" (Taken from Daring Terror)
[*] Rewrote Day 1
[*] Fixed the cursor's size
[*] Fixed Amelia not being on the left or right when two or more character was present on screen at once
[*] Fixed Day 1's code to use image compositions instead of showing images after showing images
[*] Fixed the achievement screen (Thanks to I_Am_Boredom on Discord for coding it)
[*] Updated the icons for the achievements
[*] Updated backgrounds
[*] Expanded the non-binary support to allow your look between male and female (Taken from Daring Terror)
[*] Removed all Day 1 stats increases (Love and Trust)
[*] Removed Cashier Frank, Receptionist Dave and Waitress Amora from normal gameplay
[*] Condensed all images from PNG to WEBP images
[/olist]

Before wrapping up, I just want to say thank you to everyone who helped make this whole thing possible, from the Ren'Py Discord server to the Ori Discord server (Oricord) to friends, coworkers, everyone! Alpha 0.0.2 wouldn't be possible without you guys!

I'll see you on the other side!
